reviews.title: High Hopes - Huge Let Down!
reviews.text: I am an iPad, user and acid Apple calendar, and Goodnotes user as well. I was looking for a planner app that would sync with the calendar and yet allow handwriting and more artistic flare and notetaking to blend in a little better unfortunately, what I found was an application that was very unintuitive and no help screens that I could find and I could not even find the button to add an event to my calendar. When I went to write anything if I could even get it to write it lag terribly, and sometimes appeared to be putting it on the wrong line when I went to see if it synced it didn’t show up so there must’ve been a wagon sinking or something, but the app just seemed slow laggy. I’m not sure what but definitely not something that I’m ready to use.

reviews.title: Works until it doesn’t
reviews.text: The app is really great until it deletes all of your saved data. The calendar is really nice, I love the variety of notes, but this is the second time that it is deleted all of my note data. The first time, I had to create a whole new account and restore my purchase to get my subscription back. This time, only about half of my notes have returned, the other half are gone. I have reached out to the app support team on both occasions and heard nothing back. They clearly don’t care. Purchase a subscription at your own risk.

reviews.title: Keeps crashing.
reviews.text: I really wanted to like this app as it seemed just what I wanted. I have a brand new iPad Air, and this app crashes constantly.

reviews.title: Awesome but No typing on the calendar???
reviews.text: This app is amazing it is laid out well easy to navigate easy to draw from multiple perspectives like day month year…. But you cannot type on the calendar directly only in the note section you can type. Which is like insane how do you make an amazing app that is  better than almost all other handwriting calendar apps and you forget this like super basic thing it makes basically useless on iPhone. Sorry it’s a cool app but that like blows my mind

reviews.title: I want to love it, but they won’t fix the issues or communicate
reviews.text: I’ve been using this planner for years.  I originally chose it because the information stated they would have stickers soon, the stickers never came. For the last six weeks the app on my ipad does not sync with my iPhone. I have reached out about many things with this app over the years and rarely if ever get a response and when I do it’s something like, try restarting.  I am unable to use the sync function which is a non-negotiable.  The whole point is to not have to carry your ipad or a physical calendar everywhere.  And it is not too cheap, over $50 a year for a non-functioning calendar, do not recommend.

reviews.title: Lost everything
reviews.text: Enjoyed the app for a week, when, suddenly, all my creative pencil entries and notes were lost!I emailed the company and no response. Such a cool app but beware! You may loose everything.

reviews.title: We are living in Hell
reviews.text: Just another app that pretends to be cool and customizable but in reality, all those features are locked behind a paywall. Don’t bother even downloading unless you wanna give them twenty bucks.

reviews.title: Very Disappointed!
reviews.text: I have the paid Pro subscription and the app started to glitch and I lost all my info that I used for work. I even reach out to support but got no response. Very disappointed!

reviews.title: You’ll lose everything
reviews.text: It’s great, until it decides to erase all your notes. Everyone is having this issue and they aren’t doing anything to fix it apparently. Nobody can get a hold of support and there’s no patches coming.

reviews.title: Three day trial is a joke
reviews.text: Downloaded this and quickly found it was not what I was needing, so I immediately canceled since the app offers a three-day trial.  My card was charged anyway, and two sent emails later, no response from the developers!  Beware!

reviews.title: Notes issue
reviews.text: Normally love this app but all my data has been whipped. All notes gone. Month view calendar notes gone. Everything gone. Please look into this

reviews.title: Was Great - Until it wasn’t
reviews.text: I have been using this app for a few years.  It was wonderful. I could type or use pencil.  Moving between the different view was easy and seamless.  Then one day in early 2026 it crashed and when it restarted - the appearance changed.  The links between day and month and week don’t work and the update doesn’t even have the same appearance.  I have emailed tech support several times and still haven’t heard anything back.   I was a paid subscriber  - but no more.  I am canceling my renewal.  Don’t waste your money on this.

reviews.title: Crashes every time!
reviews.text: This app is useless! Constantly crashing so I can’t even use it. Really enjoyed it when it was working.

reviews.title: Noted Disappearing
reviews.text: I’m a Pro user, and there is a bug where I lost years of notes using this app. This needs to be fixed or my subscription will be forfeited.

reviews.title: No longer works!
reviews.text: This planner was fantastic and then it stopped working a few weeks ago. My notes erase and the app no longer syncs between my iPad and iPhone. Such a bummer!

So glitch on start up.

There is still a confusing V1 / V2 different versions of the calendar. You would think they would have sorted this out by now.

Used to be good but now seriously lacking in reliability.
Needs a total redesign.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE
reviews.text: I seriously spent all day decorating my calendar so that I can have my calendar on the go instead of on my paper calendar that I hang on the wall made everything cute. Did doodles put an important dates did almost 2 months of work and I open the app again and everything was gone. Mind you this is my first day using it absolutely terrible. I don’t recommend to anyone. This was a terrible experience and it ruined most my day. Hope this helps.

reviews.title: Powerful but unreliable

reviews.title: Love at first sight then ugh…
reviews.text: I was in love with this app being able to write notes right on my calendar and then one day a bunch of my notes were empty and blank without being able to retrieve them so now I don’t trust the reliability of this and I write some of those notes to go back and look on one day. Now I know that’s not possible so I have no love for this app anymore.

reviews.title: Started off great but now it is not working well
reviews.text: I use this every day for work to write down notes and recently the notes have stopped loading or take a long time to load. I also created a note today and when I left the app, the note I created today was nowhere to be found. I already paid for this app, I would love my money back because this app is not working how it should anymore.

reviews.title: No online support
reviews.text: I was extremely happy with this app but for about two weeks now the app has been frozen and what’s worse, my notes are blank and I do case management and am extremely scared that all my notes are gone. I reached out to support but no one has reached out to me. I’m so upset.

reviews.title: NO SYNC
reviews.text: Used to love this app. Now it refuses to sync and there’s no way to fix it. Including deleting and redownloading the app. Support does not reply to messages.

reviews.title: Not worth the subscription

reviews.title: Update deleted everything
reviews.text: I’m a music teacher, I use the planner for yearly planning for my class keeps me up to date on class schedules, lessons etc. I wrote everything down planned out everything then saw it had an upstate and it deleted everything I had planned. For an app I paid for that’s so unacceptable would not be using again.

reviews.title: Notes in calendar do NOT save
reviews.text: This app could truly be the best on the store for what it does, but writing notes in your calendar is rolling the dice to whether or not they will appear the next day. It’s in need of a serious update.

reviews.title: Was in love, but…
reviews.text: I loved this app. It gave me the structure and ease of an online calendar perfect for reoccurring appointments along with the ability to write my one off appointments, doodle, make it cute like I did with my paper planner. And I was able to keep all my notes in one place and align it to dates and such. It was great until it wasn’t. I opened the app and went to my notes. And 2/4 notes pages were suddenly blank. My notes gone. As much as I loved the app, I can’t use it if I can’t trust it. Also, the ability to search definitely needs to be added.

reviews.title: Support????
reviews.text: I absolutely love the concept of this app, but I lost all my notes and handwritten messages on my calendar. I reached out for support and haven’t heard back. It looks like it was last updated over two years ago. I doubt that anything on the roadmap is going to happen.

reviews.title: Please get a different app
reviews.text: I've this app for over 2 years. I liked the look of it, but I was never able to sync the notes on all my three devices, even with the Pro version. I recently saw the need to have my notes on all three devices. I updated everything on every device, and my information was suddenly gone. All the notes from two years. I have been reaching out to tech support with no success. Please don't get this app. Customer service is not existing, just there to get out money

reviews.title: Crashing
reviews.text: This could be a great app! Easy to use, great place to keep notes. Only problem, It often crashes causing you to lose those great notes!
